verdict.rationale: Vendor docs say Marlin generates a detailed strategy report of up to a hundred pages, structured into main body, appendices and references, plus executive summary slides in PowerPoint. The output is described as ready for executive review, which covers the structured, summarized, shareable core of the story. Missing for 10: tables are never explicitly mentioned, there is no documentation of export formats or sharing features beyond the PowerPoint slides, and all evidence is vendor-published with no independent hands-on corroboration.
